title: Ocotillo Hills | Sleeps 16, 2 Casitas & Near Hikes
amenities: Pack ’n play/Travel crib - available upon request
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours
Standalone high chair - available upon request
review_snippets: This home in the mountains of Scottsdale was amazing. It was extremely spacious for my large group and everyone enjoyed have their own rooms and space. The pool is amazing and I wish I could have stayed longer!

Beautiful space, exactly as described. Casita 2 is a little far from the main house but everything met expectations and more. I came at the end of May I would definitely recommend getting the pool heated. House has amazing views of sunset and sunrise great for large groups. I definitely enjoyed my 30th with Kristie
Had a fantastic stay! The hosts were very responsive and helped us throughout the whole process. Even got the pool heat turned on for us during our stay, was a fantastic trip all thanks to the hosts!

We had the most amazing girls trip this weekend staying here. The house was spacious, comfortable and the host was very quick at replying to any questions we had. The property is even more beautiful than the photos! If you are looking for a big house to fit all your guests with a great pool and lots of activities, this is the place!
